name: ImageWise.ai
tagline: ImageWise.ai is an all-in-one AI image workspace built around visual translation
description: ImageWise.ai is an all-in-one AI image workspace built around visual translation. Upload an image and translate the text while preserving its original layout and visual context. It works with screenshots, product images, menus, posters, manga, documents, and other visuals where design matters as much as the words.
